title: Wheel Size and Low-Profile Tire Preferences
summary: Feedback centers on wheel size choices and low-profile tires, with some owners praising comfort or appearance while one review links low-profile setups to pothole-related problems and several other mentions are too varied or unclear for a firm sentiment.

positive.summary: Positive reviews praise specific wheel choices for appearance or ride comfort, especially preferring 19-inch or 22-inch wheels.

negative.summary: Negative feedback says low-profile wheels and tires create problems in pothole-heavy city driving.

undetermined.summary: Undetermined mentions discuss wheel-size preferences, range tradeoffs, and unrelated quarter-inch fit requests, so the sample is insufficient for a single clear sentiment.

limitations: Most examples are undetermined, limiting clear conclusions about sentiment.
The topic cluster mixes wheel-size comments with unrelated quarter-inch seat and pedal spacing requests.
Samples are stratified and small, so they should not be treated as representative of all owners.
